text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, heeeey! How about we hit up 
karaoke together after this?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kuu-chan-senpai, I'm gonna let you hear my 
singing voice♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Wah~! I wanna hear, I wanna hear... 
Ah.\nWait, Pandora-san, didn't you say you 
still had\nhomework due tomorrow to 
finish?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I did say that, but...! I'll do it 
when I get back! I totally got this, so no 
problem at aaall.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Really? Pulling an all-nighter is a no-go! 
Lack of sleep isn't good for your body, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Of courrrse♡ Ehehe, I'm so happy you're 
worried about me♡♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, leave it to me! Homework takes 
mere seconds for a genius like me, 
y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's great! You said you had three 
left, so I was worried~. Heh, I'd expect 
nothing less from you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, three... huh, ah!? Oh right, there 
were three of them, huh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, no way! Absolutely not! I'm totally 
in karaoke mode right now, my motivation 
to study is literally zeroooo!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-It's okay! I'll help too! I might not be 
of much help, though... If we do our best 
together, we'll work it out! Right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... okaay. If you'll do it with me, 
Kuu-chan Senpai, I'll do my best...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So... when we're done, let's go to karaoke 
together, okay? Okay? Pleeeease!!
